description:
Change the status of a schema proposal, the same action as the status menu in GraphOS Studio.
DRAFT is for work in progress, OPEN asks reviewers to review, and CLOSED abandons the proposal.
GraphOS accepts APPROVED only when the proposal has as many approvals as the graph requires, and it never accepts IMPLEMENTED from this tool.
Both return a ValidationError that names the rule.
Returns the proposal's ID and new status.
Provide the graph ID, the proposal variant name from GetProposal, and the new status.
